parts:
On 29 September 2012 01:06, Mark Webb <targetl...@gmail.com> wrote:
Thanks for your advice Graham- the 2.6.21 version works as expected.
One more issue - next to the Show Rules button in Rattle/Associate is a Show Graph button. This is not shown in your book and does nothing when clicked but give an error which I don't understand. What does it do? Can I get it to work?

Thanks again for the advice.
Regards
Mark

Thanks Mark.

The Plot button is new and a little experimental - looks like a bug in 2.6.21. It works in 2.6.22. It draws a graph of the associations discovered. If on Windows or Linux, try:

> install.pacakges("rattle", repos="http://rattle.togaware.com")

This will install the fixed version.

Regards,
Graham
